identity.name: Skeletal Muscle
identity.source_note: Live Springer Nature Link page (link.springer.com/journal/13395/submission-guidelines) is bot-blocked: a headless render returned only an Imperva 'Client Challenge' shell. The journal's own skeletalmusclejournal.biomedcentral.com author pages now 301-redirect to that blocked Springer page. Encoded from Wayback archive snapshots of the pre-migration BMC pages: research article-type page http://web.archive.org/web/20250626232204/https://skeletalmusclejournal.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript/research and general formatting page http://web.archive.org/web/20250530210034/https://skeletalmusclejournal.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript . These snapshots are ~12.5 months old (marginally beyond the 12-month window); all encoded values are stable BMC cross-journal house-style values, and every journal-specific numeric cap is left null.

encoding_notes: Publisher migration: the journal's authoring pages moved from BioMed Central (skeletalmusclejournal.biomedcentral.com) onto Springer Nature Link (link.springer.com/journal/13395); the BMC URLs now 301-redirect to Springer, whose page is served behind an Imperva 'Client Challenge' bot wall (blocked even via headless render). Content encoded from ~12.5-month-old Wayback snapshots of the BMC pages, which carry BMC's stable cross-journal house-style template.

Article-type mapping: Research->original_research; Review->review; Case report->case_report; Methodology->technical_note (BMC Methodology = new-methods/resource paper, closest slot). Journal also lists Commentary and Software article types, which have no clean enum slot and were omitted.

line_numbers set to 'continuous' from the quick-point 'Include line and page numbering'; the guide requires line numbering but does not explicitly state continuous vs per-page (continuous is BMC standard).
line_spacing/page_numbers/figure DPI(300)/figure formats/table numbering & caption position are from the general formatting page ('Preparing your manuscript', snapshot 20250530210034).
Abstract is structured with Background/Methods/Results/Conclusions, plus a conditional 'Trial registration' subsection required only for reports of health-care interventions on human participants.

references.in_text left null: the guide names the Vancouver style and numbers references in cited order (journal abbreviations per Index Medicus/MEDLINE => nlm; DOIs included; 6 authors then 'et al.' in the example) but does NOT explicitly state the in-text marker format (BMC house style is square brackets, not confirmed on-page).
No manuscript word limit, reference count limit, figure count, or table count is stated for Research (BMC does not cap these) => all such caps null.

Tables: small tables placed in-text at the appropriate location; tables larger than one A4/Letter page go at the end of the text file (placement encoded as in_text). Figure titles max 15 words, legends max 300 words, provided in the main manuscript (not the graphic).

sections/word_limits provided only for original_research (the only type whose full structure was verified); review/technical_note/case_report per-type pages were not read in detail, so their orders and caps are omitted rather than guessed.

cover_letter_required set false conservatively: BMC's supporting-information page describes cover-letter contents but on the pages read it is not stated as a hard requirement; orcid_required false (not mandated on pages read).
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'vancouver').
